dimensions.label: Problem evidence and consequence
dimensions.rationale: The adopted plan verifies the capacity problem; outage consequence needs additional operational evidence.

dimensions.label: Customer, actor, and authority clarity
dimensions.rationale: A plausible public sponsor is visible, but buyer and final approval authority are not verified.

dimensions.label: Technical and temporal fit
dimensions.rationale: A redundant fiber route is plausible, subject to route ownership, field, and right-of-way validation.

dimensions.label: Funding and procurement path
dimensions.rationale: A funding path has not yet been connected to a verified eligible applicant and scope.

dimensions.label: Strategic alignment
dimensions.rationale: The assessment fits AnchorFiber asset, route, dependency, and opportunity-intelligence capabilities.

dimensions.label: Differentiated advantage
dimensions.rationale: Evidence-linked opportunity analysis and route-dependency modeling offer a bounded differentiator.

dimensions.label: Delivery readiness
dimensions.rationale: The intelligence assessment is deliverable, but engineering and deployment partners are not named.

dimensions.label: Risk and uncertainty position
dimensions.rationale: The largest uncertainties are explicit and can be tested, but funding and right-of-way remain material.
